facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance's FY2017 fourth-quarter budget-versus-expenditure report, produced from IFMIS/IBEX, shows the enacted 2024/25 budget loaded to IFMIS and full-year outturn to Sene-2017 (July 2025) for the Artificial Intelligence Institution; the document is dated 2024-07-04 but the stated outturn is for the year ending 2025-07-07.
